notes.title: v0.94 Update!
notes.content: [h3][b]3 New Commanders[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Ratkin Infiltrator[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Ancient Toad[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Treant Elder[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]The [b]Ratkin Cheiftain[/b] has a new Commander Ability, [b]Cruel Motivation.[/b][/p][h3][/h3][p][b]Spell Selection Rework[/b] [/p][p]Spells are now free, and spellcasters can choose 2 spells. One "Cantrip", minor spell and one "Major Spell". Some hybrid spellcasters only have access to cantrips. All spellcasters have gone up 10 points in cost. The idea behind this change is that spellcaster should be versatile, and having multiple spell options to choose from in battle makes for more interesting gameplay. The current system where each spell costs points often made the optimal choice be to just play a single powerful spell.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Until End of Turn Effects[/b] [/p][p]All spells and abilities that last until end if turn have been changed to last "for one turn". This means they expire at the start of the next Strategic phase instead. The only impact of this is that movement spells now affect charge moves. Abilities like "Full Steam" and "Hunters Call " should be more attractive, and the charge range display in strategic phase is actually accurate![/p][p][/p][p][b]Balance Changes[/b] [/p][p]Goatmen have continued to over-perform a bit. Feral Giants [b]Boulder Throw[/b] is reduced to 15 points but is now single use. Mongrel skirmishers no longer have Hand Weapons. Raiding Chariots are now capped to max 2 in Warband.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Scoring Objectives Change[/b][/p][p]Objectives no longer score on turn 1.[/p][p]Single model units can no longer claim scoring objectives. Flying units can, but only if they are not single models![/p]

notes.title: v0.74 Update!
notes.content:
New Commander for the Goatmen : [b]Minotaur King [/b]
Only rolls with a Minotaur retinue and hits like a truck! Frenzy and an activated ability:  Blood Rage.

Units can now [b]flee as a reaction to being Charged[/b]. It works as a normal action during the charge phase, mouse over a charged unit to activate. The rules for being allowed to flee from a charge is:
[list]
[*] Only charged by one unit.
[*] No Frenzy
[*] No Reanimated
[*] Enough Move Speed to get out of charge range.
[/list]

[b]Commanders now survive losing their retinue[/b]. Overkill wounds on the retinue does carry over. Commanders on solo Mounts like a chariot or dragon still die if the mount dies!

[h3]Campaign Changes[/h3]

There is now a [b]global difficulty unlock level for Campaign[/b].  It's based on total amount of difficulties completed between all Commanders/Factions and will gradually unlock up to level 4.

[b]One random unit in Armory is now discounted by 25%[/b]. Adds some extra strategy and hopefully variety in unit purchases.

Strength in Numbers: Model Count +10.
Backstabbers: Re-roll Attack Rolls when attacking Flank/Rear

[b]Greater Warcry[/b] level up for commanders with Warcry. Also give +2 Move Speed to all units. 

[b]Frost Ward[/b] and [b]Shroud [/b]both have upgraded version as well.

notes.title: v0.69 Campaign Updates
notes.content:
[b] Campaign Updates[/b]
 The level up system has been expanded with a bunch of new options.
 
 Commanders can now get the "Recruiter" level up. It comes in two ranks and increases the level of newly recruited units by 1 and 2 respectively.

 Spellcasting Commanders get the option to upgrade spells they already know into stronger versions. Greater Fireball, Greater Ruin and so on.

A bunch of faction specific options have been added:

 [b]Dwarfs[/b]
    Dwarf Oaths
    Dwarf Runes (for Warmachines)

[b]Dead Nations[/b]
    Stronger Summons

[b]Elves[/b]
   Elven Spear Mastery
   Elven Bow Master
   Elven Steed Mastery

[b]Imperials[/b]
   Imperial Veterans
   Imperial Elites

[b]Ratkins[/b]
  Random Mutations!

[b]Scoring Objectives Changes[/b]
Objectives always award 50 points at end of turn if you control more than your opponent.
Objectives are "sticky", meaning they do not changes sides unless actively captured. This means you can leave an objective with your unit and it will stay captured, until your opponent takes it back (or contests it).

[b] Balance changes[/b]
 All Dead Nations Commanders have the Unholy Vigour spell as a base ability, for free.
 Unholy Vigour now last until the units first combat

    Prowess from 20 to 15 pts
     Banner of Fury from 30 to 20 pts
     Banner of Valor from 25 to 15 pts
     Cursed Standard from 45 to 40 pts
     War Banner from 35 to 25 pts

     Cruelty from 15 to 20 pts
     Hex of Ruin from 30 to 35 pts

     Arcane Web +1 charge
     Arcane Web from 30 to 35 pts

     Tyrannosaur mount from 55 to 60 pts

     Firelizard from 45 to 60 pts
     Firelizard no longer has Swift
     Firelizard no longer a 2 for 1 pick in Ranged Support
     FIrelizard +1 Wounds

[b]Charge Phase Tweak[/b]
Charge declaration has been been tweaked a bit and had some bugs fixed, especially related to "Path to unit" and flying units.


[b]Other[/b]
You can now play the campaign with unlocked alternate commander art.

Timing out in Ranked no longer concedes the game, instead it skips the activation/phase. There is also a bigger warning when you are about to run out.

Lots of general bug fixes!

notes.title: v0.64 Ranked Multiplayer Updates
notes.content:
0.64 is out with some interesting changes to Ranked multiplayer!

[list]

[*] [b]Skill Based Match Making[/b] is now turned on in Ranked. It will try to match you against players with similar skill (Elo). Works better when there are a lot of people playing. For people at the extremes (high or low) of the bell curve, queue times might be a bit longer. There are a lot of numbers to tweak here, so give me your feedback on how it works for you!

[*] Ranked multiplayer has a new scenario, [b]Scoring Objectives[/b]. The scenario is randomly choose, 1/3 chance of one objective, 1/3 chance of two, and 1/3 chance of being a regular pitched battle.
Claim objectives by moving a unit into it's zone of influence. If both player have a unit in the zone, the objective is contested. Single objective gives 50 points at end of turn, double gives 25 each. Flyers and fleeing units are not able to claim/contest. Scoring objectives are a good way to encourage aggressive play and get rid of "corner camping"!

[*] Some minor [b]balance changes[/b]: City Guard, elf Archers, Imperial Archers, Imperial Crossbows, Imperial Handguns all have max unit size 15 in Warband size armies.

[*] Lots of bug fixes!

[/list]

notes.title: v0.51 Update: Competitive and UX
notes.content:
0.51 is out, lots of stuff!
 
[list]
[*] [b]2 new units.[/b] The [b]Doom Bell[/b] is a mount for Ratkin Warlocks. The sound of the bell sends your rats into a murderous frenzy! Dead Nations get a [b]Zombie Giant[/b]. It's a giant zombie. Yup.
[*] [b]Timers in multiplayer[/b]. Players now have limited time to complete deployment and unit activations. Pretty generous, 2 mins per activation and 4 mins for Deployment. May be changed based on feedback!
[*] [b]Equal Activations[/b]: Both players now have equal amount of activations in the strategic phase. If you have fewer units than your opponent you can use your extra activations to "Pass" the turn. This strategic advantage should make smaller, elite armies more viable!
[*] [b]Updated Scoring[/b] for multiplayer: you now also gain points for units at half strength.
[*] Some [b]AI improvements[/b] and fixes. Most notably the AI should be much better at actually moving units into charge range, avoiding obstacles.
[*] [b]Cover system[/b] changes. Cover now affects ranged attacks from warmachines as well, reducing the number of hits by one (per die). "Protected Crew" and the "Banner of Mist" both give units permanent Cover effect.
[*] Option to [b]"undo" unit activations[/b] if you change your mind before doing anything
[*] [b]Spacebar[/b] now advances the game in all phases. If you still have actions left to perform you need to hit spacebar twice to confirm, to avoid accidentally ending a phase.
[*] [b]Balance tweaks[/b]: Flying mounts and Chariots have had some points tweaks. All Warmachines and Chariots are now at 5 wounds. Ratkin Longrifles up to Skill 4. 
[*] Lots of bug fixes!
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.17
notes.content:
[b]Visual Stuff[/b]
 [list]
[*] Units look a little fancier, and each faction has a unique look. Orcs are dirty, undead tattered and broken, elves fancy with golden borders, dwarves with a stony texture and so on...
[*] Units get bloodied when they kill a lot of dudes.
[*] Arrows stick around in the ground forever now.
[/list]
[b]Naming[/b]
 [list]
[*] Units and commanders can be given names in the army editor and campaign.
[*] Units and commanders have random name generators, new units will get named automatically. 
[/list]
[b]UI Tweaks[/b]
  [list]
[*]  A lot of UI has been reworked, especially in battle. This will probably take a while to get used to, but they definitely feel better to me after playing a while. Main things are:
[*]  The Event log has been cleaned up a lot. Only important information is shown, details have been moved to mouse overs.
[*]  The dice box (where you roll dice) has also been cleaned up.
[*]  Interface during combat has been changed a lot! Dice rolling is moved to the center, the combat score at the top is much clearer.
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]  Should no longer freeze on post battle screen in campaign.
[*]  AI units will no longer try to target dead units. This led to some really weird movement behaviour.
[*]  AI units can now properly use the Army Wide buffs. Before they only targeted one unit.
[*]   A ton more!
[/list]
